column2: WASTE PRACTICES ASSESSMENT — 40 Questions Across All Waste Management Areas
Score each practice honestly.  ✓ = Fully in place (consistent, documented)  △ = Partially in place (started but incomplete)  ✗ = Not in place  N/A = Not applicable to your business

column3: PRACTICE / QUESTION
column5: BUSINESS RISK IF NOT IN PLACE

column3: Does your business separate waste into at least 3 categories: organic/food waste, recyclables, and general waste?
column5: CRITICAL — Mixed waste cannot be recycled or composted; illegal disposal risk; higher contractor costs
column6: Quy định phân loại rác Nghị định 45/2022/NĐ-CP

column3: Are separation bins correctly labelled, in the right locations, and accessible to all staff?
column5: HIGH — Unlabelled bins mean separation doesn't happen in practice even if policy exists

column3: Do you separate hazardous waste (oils, chemicals, batteries) from general waste?
column5: CRITICAL — Illegal to mix hazardous waste with general waste; environmental authority fine risk

column3: Is food/organic waste separated daily and stored correctly before collection?
column5: HIGH — Improperly stored organic waste: odour complaints, pest risk, health authority inspection

column3: Do all staff — including part-time and new hires — know which bin to use for each waste type?
column5: HIGH — Knowledge lives only with a few people; inconsistent sorting undermines entire system

column3: Is waste separation checked or verified by a supervisor at least weekly?
column5: MEDIUM — Without supervision, compliance declines; contamination of recyclable streams increases

column3: Do you use a licensed waste collection contractor for all non-general waste?
column5: CRITICAL — Unlicensed disposal is illegal; business owner is legally liable for improper disposal

column3: Do you hold a current copy of your contractor's waste disposal licence?
column5: HIGH — Cannot prove compliance in an inspection without this document

column3: Does your contractor provide disposal certificates or manifests for hazardous waste?
column5: CRITICAL — Required by law for hazardous waste; failure = significant fine

column3: Do you have a written service agreement with your waste contractor?
column5: HIGH — No contract = no recourse if contractor mishandles waste and your business is implicated

column3: Have you verified that your contractor actually disposes of waste correctly (not dumping)?
column5: HIGH — Businesses have been fined when their contractor was found illegally dumping

column3: Do you track and retain waste collection receipts or records for at least 3 years?
column5: HIGH — Required for regulatory inspections; cannot demonstrate compliance without records

column3: Is your waste storage area clean, covered, and separated from food preparation or production areas?
column5: CRITICAL — Health authority violation; cross-contamination risk; customer/staff complaints

column3: Are waste bins and containers in good repair (no leaks, lids working)?
column5: MEDIUM — Leaking bins: leachate contamination; pest attraction; odour complaints

column3: Is there a designated, signed area for waste collection vehicle access?
column5: LOW — Undesignated access causes operational disruptions and safety incidents

column3: Are hazardous materials stored in a separate, ventilated, and labelled area before disposal?
column5: CRITICAL — Fire risk, chemical reaction risk, regulatory violation

column3: Is the waste storage area checked and cleaned at least weekly?
column5: MEDIUM — Neglected waste areas attract pests and cause odour complaints from neighbours

column3: Do all staff receive waste handling training as part of their induction?
column5: HIGH — New staff are the most common source of waste compliance failures

column3: Is waste handling included in staff performance expectations or team briefings?
column5: MEDIUM — Waste practices not reinforced = gradual compliance drift

column3: Is there a clear person responsible for waste management in your business?
column5: HIGH — Without ownership, waste systems are managed by nobody

column3: Do staff report waste management problems (broken bins, wrong disposal, pest sightings) promptly?
column5: MEDIUM — Unreported issues compound; small problems become regulatory incidents

column3: Have you had any staff-related waste incidents (wrong disposal, contamination) in the past 12 months?
column5: N/A if none — if yes, was a root cause identified and corrected?

column3: Do you track how much food waste you produce each week by source (prep, spoilage, customer plate waste)?
column5: HIGH — Cannot reduce what you don't measure; food waste typically 3–8% of revenue for restaurants

column3: Do you have a process for ordering ingredients based on actual usage rather than estimate?
column5: HIGH — Over-ordering is the #1 driver of food waste; direct cost to food margin

column3: Are perishables stored using FIFO (first in, first out) to minimise spoilage?
column5: HIGH — FIFO failures result in preventable spoilage; direct cost loss

column3: Do kitchen staff have a process for using off-spec or near-expiry ingredients (e.g. specials, staff meals)?
column5: MEDIUM — Usable food discarded when repurposing process doesn't exist

column3: Do you track plate waste (food left by customers) to identify over-portioning?
column5: MEDIUM — Systematic over-portioning wastes food and increases cost per cover

column3: Have you taken any actions to reduce single-use plastic or packaging in the past 12 months?
column5: MEDIUM — Growing regulatory pressure; customer expectation; reputational risk

column3: Do you have effluent treatment or containment for any liquid waste from your production process?
column5: CRITICAL — Untreated effluent into public sewers or waterways is a serious legal violation
column6: Luật Bảo vệ Môi trường 2020, QCVN 40:2011

column3: Is dust or particulate matter from your production process contained and managed?
column5: HIGH — Dust complaints from neighbours trigger environmental authority inspections

column3: Are noise levels from your operations within permissible limits at the boundary of your site?
column5: HIGH — Noise violations are a common trigger for regulatory complaints in industrial zones

column3: Are chemicals and hazardous materials stored with secondary containment (bunding)?
column5: CRITICAL — Spill into drainage = environmental incident; major fine; operational shutdown risk

column3: Do you have a spill response procedure and kit on site?
column5: HIGH — Without a response plan, a spill escalates quickly and cleanup costs multiply
